entryInfo.reason: Bullish flag breakout with strong volume confirmation

notes: Perfect execution of momentum trading strategy. Followed pre-market analysis and trading plan strictly. Entry at bullish flag breakout with multiple technical confirmations (RSI, MACD, EMA crossover) and strong fundamental support (GDP data, FII buying). Exit at resistance as planned when RSI became overbought and volume declined. Emotional discipline maintained throughout - no FOMO, no greed at exit. Risk management worked perfectly with 2.5:1 reward-risk ratio achieved.

entryReasoning.primaryReason: Bullish flag breakout with strong momentum and positive fundamentals
entryReasoning.reasoningSummary: Strong bullish setup with multiple technical confirmations and positive fundamental backdrop. RSI and MACD showing momentum, bullish flag pattern formed with high volume breakout. GDP data positive at 7.2%, FII buying strong at 2500 Cr inflow. Entry at breakout of flag pattern at 22450.75 with good risk-reward ratio of 2.5:1. Stop loss at 22350, targeting 22650 resistance level.

exitReasoning.primaryReason: Resistance level reached with overbought RSI and weakening momentum
exitReasoning.reasoningSummary: Exited at predetermined resistance level of 22675 as per trading plan. RSI showing overbought conditions above 70, volume declining at resistance indicating weakening momentum, minor bearish divergence forming on 5-min chart. Profit target of 1% achieved successfully. Risk-reward ratio of 2.5:1 captured. Adhered to trading plan - booked profits at resistance rather than being greedy. US futures weakness in afternoon provided additional confirmation for exit.
